keyPoints: Chumbak (magnet) loha, nickel aur cobalt jaisi cheezon ko apni taraf kheenchta hai; ye kheenchav bina chhue bhi mehsoos hota hai.
Har chumbak ke do dhruv hote hain — uttar dhruv (N) aur dakshin dhruv (S); beech se todne par bhi har tukde me dono dhruv apne aap ban jaate hain, akele dhruv kabhi nahi milta.
Samaan dhruv ek-dusre ko dhakelte hain (N-N ya S-S) aur viprit dhruv ek-dusre ko kheenchet hain (N-S); isi niyam par fridge ke darwaze aur khilone kaam karte hain.
Chumbak ka prabhav uske aas-paas ke kshetra me hota hai, jise chumbakiya kshetra (magnetic field) kehte hain; lohe ka burada chhidakne par iski rekhaen dikhai deti hain.
Lohe ki keel ko chumbak se ek hi disha me baar-baar ghisne par wo asthaayi chumbak ban jaati hai, jo kuch din baad apna gun kho deti hai.
Dishasuchak (compass) me lagi chhoti sui khud ek chumbak hoti hai jo hamesha uttar-dakshin disha me rukti hai; yatri aur jahaz isi se raasta paate hain.
Aam galti: chumbak har dhatu ko kheenchta hai ye sochna; wo plastic, lakdi, taamba ya aluminium ko nahi kheenchta, sirf chumbakiya padarthon ko kheenchta hai.
